nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the $n$-th block is the list of the odd numbers $1, 3, \ldots, 2n - 1$ in increasing order followed by the even numbers $2n, 2n - 2, \ldots, 2$ in decreasing order; the $0$-th block is empty.
nodes.title: Blocks of the Smarandache permutation sequence

nodes.summary: Indexing the Smarandache permutation sequence $(a_i)_{i \ge 0}$ from $0$, its twelfth term is $a_{11} = 2$.
nodes.title: Twelfth term of the Smarandache permutation sequence

nodes.summary: Indexing the Smarandache permutation sequence $(a_i)_{i \ge 0}$ from $0$, its sixth term is $a_5 = 2$.

nodes.summary: Indexing the Smarandache permutation sequence $(a_i)_{i \ge 0}$ from $0$, its initial term is $a_0 = 1$.
nodes.title: Initial term of the Smarandache permutation sequence

nodes.summary: The Smarandache permutation sequence (OEIS A004741) is the sequence $(a_i)_{i \ge 0}$ of natural numbers, indexed from $0$, obtained by concatenating the blocks $(1, 3, \ldots, 2n - 1, 2n, 2n - 2, \ldots, 2)$ for $n = 1, 2, 3, \ldots$ in order; it begins $1, 2, 1, 3, 4, 2, 1, 3, 5, 6, 4, 2, \ldots$, so $a_0 = 1$.
nodes.title: Smarandache permutation sequence

nodes.summary: Concatenating the first three blocks of the Smarandache permutation sequence gives $(1, 2, 1, 3, 4, 2, 1, 3, 5, 6, 4, 2)$.
nodes.title: Concatenation of the first three Smarandache blocks

nodes.summary: For a natural number $N$, this is the list of natural numbers obtained by concatenating, in order, the Smarandache blocks numbered $1, 2, \dots, N$, where block $n$ is the list $(1, 3, \dots, 2n - 1, 2n, 2n - 2, \dots, 2)$ of the odd numbers below $2n$ in increasing order followed by the even numbers from $2n$ down to $2$. For $N = 0$ it is the empty list.
nodes.title: Prefix of the Smarandache permutation sequence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
